summary: Two IDF soldiers were killed and four wounded in a shooting attack at Judea Junction near Hebron, prompting an IDF raid in Hebron and full closure of the area. Saudi Arabia intercepted 11 Houthi drones and a ballistic missile, while foreign ministers from eight nations met in Istanbul warning that renewed attacks on Iran would expand the conflict. An IAI Eitan Heron drone was observed over southern Beirut, and Israeli military exercises are scheduled for October 25-26.
key_points: Two IDF soldiers from the 775th 'Ari' Battalion killed in shooting attack at Judea Junction near Hebron; gunmen used assault rifle and pistol from covered positions. (Source: @amitsegal/66109)
IDF Chief of Staff states terrorists' vehicle contained large ammunition cache, indicating plans for a larger attack. (Source: @amitsegal/66102)
IDF launches raid in Hebron, operating at gunmen's homes with demolition plans; Hebron and surrounding villages under full closure. (Source: @manniefabian/59410)
Saudi coalition intercepted 11 Houthi drones and a ballistic missile over Riyadh, Medina, Eastern Province, and toward Najran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8798)

Foreign ministers from Turkey, Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, UK, France, Germany, Italy met in Istanbul; agree renewed attacks on Iran would expand conflict, call for diplomacy. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8800)
IAI Eitan Heron drone flew silently over southern Beirut suburbs (Dahiyeh) from morning, spotted at 3 PM. (Source: @redlinkleb/49500)
Israeli military announces exercise October 25-26 in north and central areas with Air Force, training for multi-front defense and escalation scenarios. (Source: @redlinkleb/49501)
UK ends sanctions exemption for essential transactions through five Iranian banks as of October 22. (Source: @shin_persian/11398)

sections.executive_summary: Two IDF soldiers were killed and four wounded in a shooting attack at Judea Junction near Hebron, prompting an IDF raid in Hebron and full closure of the area. Saudi Arabia intercepted 11 Houthi drones and a ballistic missile, while foreign ministers from eight nations met in Istanbul warning that renewed attacks on Iran would expand the conflict. An IAI Eitan Heron drone was observed over southern Beirut, and Israeli military exercises are scheduled for October 25-26.

points: The United Kingdom will not renew an exemption allowing essential transactions through five Iranian banks, ending the authorization on October 22, according to IRGC-affiliated Tasnim news agency. (Source: @shin_persian/11398)
A Russian government plane was observed taxiing at Mehrabad airport in Tehran, indicating continued Russian-Iranian diplomatic or military coordination. (Source: @shin_persian/11405)
No missile launch occurred from Tehran today; an observed trail over the city was identified as a jet aircraft, not a missile. (Source: @shin_persian/11403)

Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan stated that renewed attacks against Iran would escalate tensions and increase violence, reflecting regional concern over potential Israeli strikes. (Source: @N12chat/231409)

Foreign ministers from Turkey, Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Britain, France, Germany, and Italy met in Istanbul to discuss the Iran war, agreeing that renewed attacks on Iran would expand the conflict and calling for diplomatic solutions. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8800)

Two IDF soldiers, Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman (23) and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem (20), both from the Home Front Command's 775th 'Ari' Search and Rescue Battalion, were killed in a shooting attack at Judea Junction on Route 35 near Hebron. (Source: @amitsegal/66109)

IDF Chief of Staff Herzi Halevi stated that the terrorists' vehicle contained a large quantity of ammunition, indicating they planned a larger attack, possibly targeting Israeli civilians on Route 35. (Source: @amitsegal/66102)

The IDF launched a raid in the Hebron area, operating at the homes of the two Palestinian gunmen with plans to demolish them; Hebron and other Palestinian villages in the area are under full closure. (Source: @manniefabian/59410)

The attack occurred around 7:30 AM at a temporary checkpoint at the exit from Hebron; the two gunmen, armed with an assault rifle and a pistol, exited their car on a side street and used buildings as cover to open fire on soldiers conducting routine vehicle checks. (Source: @manniefabian/59409)
Four people were wounded in the attack: two in serious condition, two lightly hurt; one of the wounded is unconscious, according to Magen David Adom. (Source: @manniefabian/59402)

The Israeli military announced a two-day exercise on October 25-26 in northern and central Israel, involving the Air Force and ground forces, to train for multi-front defense scenarios and prepare for escalation. (Source: @redlinkleb/49501)

US military aircraft, including a C-17 Globemaster III strategic transport and an E-3 Sentry AWACS, were tracked over Palestinian airspace, indicating heightened US air activity in the region. (Source: @redlinkleb/49512, @redlinkleb/49523)
A shooting attack was reported at Judea Junction on Route 35 near Hebron in the southern West Bank, with at least one person initially reported injured. (Source: @manniefabian/59399)
IDF forces opened fire at a Palestinian in the 'Scientists Square' area in Hebron, according to initial reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/136678)
IDF forces arrived at the homes of the attackers in Hebron following the shooting attack. (Source: @yediotnews25/136679)
Dramatic footage from the helmet camera of the Kiryat Arba security officer captured the attack. (Source: @yediotnews25/136689)
AFP published photos showing the two Palestinian gunmen who carried out the shooting attack. (Source: @manniefabian/59405)
Hebron and other Palestinian villages in the area are under full closure by the Israeli military following the attack. (Source: @manniefabian/59410)
An IAI Eitan Heron drone was observed flying silently over the southern suburbs of Beirut (Dahiyeh) from the morning, with visual confirmation at 3 PM. (Source: @redlinkleb/49500)
Drone activity is focused on the Shweifat-Amrusiyah-Hay al-Salam-airport corridor, with maximum caution advised. (Source: @redlinkleb/49511)
Artillery shelling was reported in the Zoutar al-Sharqiyah area, with a live map tracking the strikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/49487)
Warplane activity was detected in southern Lebanon, with a live map tracking movements. (Source: @redlinkleb/49505)

The US Transportation Department fined Air France and KLM a total of $425,000 for operating dozens of flights in Iraqi airspace below the minimum altitude intended to protect them from ground threats. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8795)
The US authorized an emergency release of up to 400,000 barrels of oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, bringing the reserve to its lowest level since 1982. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8794)

Saudi coalition forces intercepted 11 Houthi drones and a ballistic missile in attacks across Saudi Arabia yesterday, including over Riyadh, Medina, the Eastern Province, and toward Najran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8798)
An emergency warning was issued for Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, by the Saudi Civil Defense. (Source: @shin_persian/11401)
Brent crude oil price reached $117.21 per barrel, reflecting market tension over regional escalation. (Source: @shin_persian/11413)
The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) issued Warning 181-26 for maritime security in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/11412)

Foreign ministers from Turkey, Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Britain, France, Germany, and Italy met in Istanbul to discuss the Iran war, agreeing that renewed attacks on Iran would expand the conflict and calling for diplomatic solutions. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8800)

sections.threat_assessment: The shooting attack near Hebron demonstrates the continued capability of Palestinian militants to conduct coordinated assaults on Israeli military targets in the West Bank, with the attackers' heavy ammunition loadout indicating intent for a larger massacre. The IDF's immediate raid and closure of Hebron signal a robust counter-terrorism response that may trigger further unrest. Simultaneously, the Houthi drone and missile barrage against Saudi Arabia, coupled with the Istanbul diplomatic meeting, reveals a regional axis actively testing Saudi air defenses while major powers seek to contain Iranian escalation. The persistent Israeli drone presence over Beirut and scheduled multi-front exercises suggest Israel is preparing for potential northern escalation, possibly linked to Iranian-backed threats. The UK banking sanctions rollback adds economic pressure on Iran, which may provoke asymmetric retaliation.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's successful interception of 11 Houthi drones and a ballistic missile demonstrates improved integrated air defense capabilities, but the scale of the attack indicates Houthi willingness to saturate defenses. The Istanbul meeting of eight foreign ministers, including key US allies and regional rivals, reflects a rare consensus that military escalation against Iran risks uncontrollable regional war, favoring diplomatic off-ramps. Turkey's explicit warning against renewed attacks on Iran aligns with its broader mediation role. The emergency warning in Riyadh and UKMTO maritime alert show Gulf states bracing for further Houthi or Iranian-backed strikes. The US strategic petroleum release and fines on European carriers over Iraqi airspace violations highlight Washington's dual focus on energy security and enforcing safety corridors amid heightened threat environments.
sections.intelligence_notes: The presence of a Russian government aircraft at Tehran's Mehrabad airport suggests ongoing high-level coordination between Moscow and Tehran, potentially involving military technology transfer or strategic planning. The US C-17 and E-3 AWACS flights over Palestinian airspace indicate enhanced American ISR and logistical support for Israeli operations, possibly in anticipation of multi-front conflict. The identification of the Tehran aerial trail as a jet rather than a missile underscores the fog of war and the risk of miscalculation. The UK's termination of banking exemptions for Iranian institutions removes a key sanctions relief valve, likely accelerating Iran's shift to alternative financial channels. The AFP documentation of the Hebron gunmen provides rare visual intelligence on attacker profiles and equipment, valuable for future threat profiling.
